objects.description: Non-owning, read-only view over a contiguous sequence of chars, compatible with std::string_view. Provides iterators, capacity, element access, find/search utilities, comparisons, and substring operations. Does not manage lifetime of underlying data. Deleted nullptr constructor; default constructs to null/empty. Size limited to ptrdiff_t max.

objects.description: Enum specifying minimum field width and fill style for hexadecimal/decimal formatting helpers. kZeroPadN uses '0' padding; kSpacePadN uses space padding. kNoPad implies width 1.

Formatting helper that captures a value and padding policy for hexadecimal output used by AlphaNum/StrCat. Accepts integers or pointers; computes width/fill from PadSpec. Provides AbslStringify for sink-based formatting.

Formatting helper capturing value and padding settings for decimal output. Used by AlphaNum and StrCat/StrAppend when explicit padded decimal formatting is desired. Supports negative values and sign placement with zero padding.

Lightweight non-owning adaptor used as parameter type for StrCat/StrAppend. Converts many primitive types and string-like inputs to an internal absl::string_view without allocations, using internal buffers for numeric formatting. Not intended for direct instantiation as a variable; use only as function parameter.

functions.name: absl::string_view::begin
functions.description: Returns an iterator (const char*) to the first character of the view, or end() if empty. Use for ranged-for and STL algorithms.
requirements: The underlying string data referenced by this view must outlive the iterator usage.
Dereferencing the returned iterator is only valid if the view is non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::end
functions.description: Returns a past-the-end iterator (const char*) for the view. Do not dereference.
requirements: Do not dereference the returned iterator; it is a sentinel.
The underlying string data must remain valid while the iterator is used.

functions.name: absl::string_view::cbegin
functions.description: Returns a const iterator to the first character; equivalent to begin().
requirements: Underlying data must outlive iterator usage.
Dereferencing only valid when the view is non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::cend
functions.description: Returns a past-the-end const iterator; equivalent to end().
requirements: Do not dereference the returned iterator; it is a sentinel.
Underlying data must remain valid while the iterator is used.

functions.name: absl::string_view::rbegin
functions.description: Returns a reverse iterator to the last character, or rend() if empty.
requirements: Underlying data must outlive iterator usage.
Dereferencing the returned iterator is only valid if the view is non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::rend
functions.description: Returns a reverse past-the-begin iterator. Do not dereference.
requirements: Do not dereference the returned iterator; it is a sentinel.
Underlying data must remain valid while the iterator is used.

functions.name: absl::string_view::crbegin
functions.description: Returns a const reverse iterator to the last character; equivalent to rbegin().
requirements: Underlying data must outlive iterator usage.
Dereferencing only valid when the view is non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::crend
functions.description: Returns a const reverse past-the-begin iterator; equivalent to rend().
requirements: Do not dereference the returned iterator; it is a sentinel.
Underlying data must remain valid while the iterator is used.

functions.name: absl::string_view::size
functions.description: Returns the number of characters in the view.

functions.name: absl::string_view::length
functions.description: Alias for size(); returns the number of characters in the view.

functions.name: absl::string_view::max_size
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of characters the view can represent.

functions.name: absl::string_view::empty
functions.description: Returns true if the view is empty (size() == 0).

functions.name: absl::string_view::operator[]
functions.description: Returns the character at index i without bounds checking. Asserts in hardening builds if i >= size().
requirements: i must be in the range [0, size()).
The view must remain valid for the returned reference.

functions.name: absl::string_view::at
functions.description: Returns the character at index i with bounds checking; throws std::out_of_range if i >= size().
requirements: i must be in the range [0, size()); otherwise std::out_of_range is thrown.
The view must remain valid for the returned reference.

functions.name: absl::string_view::front
functions.description: Returns the first character of the view. Asserts in hardening builds if empty.
requirements: The view must be non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::back
functions.description: Returns the last character of the view. Asserts in hardening builds if empty.
requirements: The view must be non-empty.

functions.name: absl::string_view::data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying character array (not necessarily NUL-terminated). May contain embedded NULs.
requirements: Do not pass the returned pointer to APIs requiring NUL-termination unless you know the data is NUL-terminated.
The view must remain valid while the pointer is used.

functions.name: absl::string_view::remove_prefix
functions.description: Removes the first n characters from the view (adjusts the view only; does not modify underlying data).
requirements: n must be <= size().

functions.name: absl::string_view::remove_suffix
functions.description: Removes the last n characters from the view (adjusts the view only).
requirements: n must be <= size().

functions.name: absl::string_view::swap
functions.description: Swaps the contents of this view with another view. No allocation; swaps pointer and length.
requirements: Argument s must be a valid absl::string_view.

functions.name: absl::string_view::copy
functions.signature: absl::string_view::size_type absl::string_view::copy(char* buf, absl::string_view::size_type n, absl::string_view::size_type pos = 0) const
functions.description: Copies up to n characters starting at offset pos into buf; returns the number of characters copied. Throws std::out_of_range if pos > size().
requirements: buf must be non-null and point to writable memory for at least min(n, size() - pos) bytes.
pos must be <= size(); otherwise std::out_of_range is thrown.

functions.name: absl::string_view::substr

functions.description: Returns a view of the substring starting at pos of length up to n. Throws std::out_of_range if pos > size().
requirements: pos must be <= size(); otherwise std::out_of_range is thrown.

functions.name: absl::string_view::compare
functions.description: Lexicographically compares this view to x. Returns <0, 0, or >0 for less, equal, or greater.

functions.description: Finds the last position at or before pos containing a character not in s; returns position or npos.

data_types.description: A buffer of arbitrary bytes of any length, possibly including NUL (0x00) and non-UTF-8 sequences. No specific encoding or structure is assumed. May be empty. Used wherever an API accepts generic string/byte data (e.g., absl::string_view constructed from std::string contents).

generators.generator:
import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets inputs for fuzzers using absl::string_view, NullSafeStringView, and StrAppend.
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR provides std::string data that will back string_views or be appended.
# We therefore generate valid C-style and arbitrary byte strings with interesting characteristics:
# - ASCII words, numbers, hex/dec patterns
# - Strings with embedded NULs (for string_view but meaningful for c_str paths we avoid NUL when used via c_str)
# - Empty and very long strings (bounded)
# - Repeated characters and mixed whitespace
# - Prefix/suffix markers to exercise starts_with/ends_with paths
# - Printable + non-printable bytes, including 0x00, 0xFF
# - Palindromes / symmetric patterns
# - Random decimal/hex representations to be used alongside AlphaNum Hex/Dec output in StrAppend
# The fuzzer stubs:
# - NullSafeStringView sometimes uses s.c_str(): that path relies on NUL termination and strlen(). Our produced string
#   is a std::string, so embedded NULs are permitted; strlen() will stop at the first NUL, which is valid and tested.
# - absl::string_view producer copies FUZZ_PARAM_STR bytes into a heap buffer without requiring NUL terminator; any bytes are valid.
# - StrAppend compares byte-for-byte; any bytes are fine.
# We encode everything as bytes; the harness will interpret them as a std::string via FUZZ_PARAM_STR.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

PRINTABLE = bytes([c for c in range(32, 127)])
WHITES = b" \t\r\n\v\f"
HEXDIG = b"0123456789abcdefABCDEF"
DIGITS = b"0123456789"


def _rand_bytes(rnd: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rnd.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))


def _chunk_prob(rnd: random.Random, p: float) -> bool:
    return rnd.random() < p


def _make_ascii_word(rnd: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=64) -> bytes:
    length = rnd.randint(min_len, max_len)
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_"
    return ''.join(rnd.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length)).encode('ascii')


def _make_repeated(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    ch = rnd.choice([b"0", b"1", b" ", b"\t", b"A", b"a", b"x", b"\x00", b"\xff"])  # type: ignore
    count = rnd.randint(1, 512)
    return ch * count


def _make_numeric(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Mix of decimal and hex with optional signs and padding
    if _chunk_prob(rnd, 0.5):
        # Decimal
        sign = rnd.choice([b"", b"-", b"+"])
        width = rnd.randint(1, 20)
        pad = rnd.choice([b"", b"0" * rnd.randint(2, 8), b" " * rnd.randint(2, 8)])
        num = bytes(rnd.choice(DIGITS) for _ in range(width))
        return sign + pad + num
    else:
        # Hex (with 0x optional)
        prefix = rnd.choice([b"", b"0x", b"0X"])
        width = rnd.randint(1, 16)
        num = bytes(rnd.choice(HEXDIG) for _ in range(width))
        return prefix + num


def _make_with_nulls(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create a string with embedded NULs (to affect strlen in NullSafeStringView when not null)
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    k = rnd.randint(2, 6)
    for i in range(k):
        seg_len = rnd.randint(0, 32)
        seg = bytes(rnd.choice(PRINTABLE) for _ in range(seg_len))
        parts.append(seg)
        if i != k - 1:
            parts.append(b"\x00" * rnd.randint(1, 3))
    return b"".join(parts)


def _make_whitespacey(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    n = rnd.randint(1, 200)
    return bytes(rnd.choice(WHITES) for _ in range(n))


def _make_marked(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Prefix/suffix markers common in starts_with/ends_with tests
    prefixes = [b"http://", b"https://", b"file://", b"0x", b"-", b"+", b"[", b"("]
    suffixes = [b".txt", b".bin", b"/", b"]", b")", b"\n", b"\r\n"]
    mid = _rand_bytes(rnd, rnd.randint(0, 64))
    return rnd.choice(prefixes) + mid + rnd.choice(suffixes)


def _make_palindrome(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    left = _rand_bytes(rnd, rnd.randint(0, 64))
    return left + left[::-1]


def _make_printable(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    n = rnd.randint(1, 512)
    return bytes(rnd.choice(PRINTABLE) for _ in range(n))


def _make_mix(rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Combine multiple chunks to increase coverage in StrAppend comparisons
    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    count = rnd.randint(2, 8)
    factories = [
        _make_ascii_word,
        _make_numeric,
        _make_repeated,
        _make_with_nulls,
        _make_whitespacey,
        _make_marked,
        _make_palindrome,
        _make_printable,
    ]
    for _ in range(count):
        f = rnd.choice(factories)
        chunks.append(f(rnd))
    # Occasionally interleave small random bytes
    if _chunk_prob(rnd, 0.3):
        for i in range(rnd.randint(1, 3)):
            pos = rnd.randint(0, len(chunks))
            chunks.insert(pos, _rand_bytes(rnd, rnd.randint(1, 8)))
    return b"".join(chunks)


def _cap(b: bytes) -> bytes:
    if len(b) > MAX_TOTAL:
        return b[:MAX_TOTAL]
    return b


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose a strategy ensuring a broad distribution
    strategies = [
        _make_ascii_word,
        _make_numeric,
        _make_repeated,
        _make_with_nulls,
        _make_whitespacey,
        _make_marked,
        _make_palindrome,
        _make_printable,
        _make_mix,
    ]

    # Sometimes emit empty to exercise empty view paths
    if _chunk_prob(rnd, 0.12):
        return b""

    # Sometimes emit a very long buffer
    if _chunk_prob(rnd, 0.18):
        # Build from mixed chunks up to cap
        out = bytearray()
        while len(out) < MAX_TOTAL:
            piece = rnd.choice(strategies)(rnd)
            # Keep appending until we approach the cap
            if len(out) + len(piece) > MAX_TOTAL:
                piece = piece[: MAX_TOTAL - len(out)]
            out += piece
            if _chunk_prob(rnd, 0.35):
                break
        return bytes(out)

    # Typical size
    out = rnd.choice(strategies)(rnd)
    return _cap(out)
